problems.problem: The right column carries only three faint elements: 'BVLGARI' at 30px, the two-line title, and a hairline rule at y=1008 whose #6f9aa8 ink nearly vanishes against the #d3dbe0 nacre (visible in the poster as a barely perceptible smear under 'Crystalline'). The subtitle and price strings are empty, so the column reads as a floating fragment rather than the declared editorial right rail; references 1 and 4 sustain their columns with logo, title, descriptor and footer lines in clear stepped weights.

The generated nacre swirl is busier andHigher-contrast than the concept's 'matte shell grain, quiet cool grey right half': bright white sparkle clusters sit directly behind the title block (around x 620-700, y 700-1000) and across the right rail, competing with the type and breaking the intended calm field that should carry the column.

Contact is genuine: the enlarged base crop shows the disc rim meeting the shell ground with a soft compressed shadow line at base_y 1237, offset_y 0 is correct and must not move. However the shadow is a thin uniform sliver (opacity 0.35, blur 10) with no broader ambient occlusion spreading into the shell joints, so the heavy double disc reads slightly lighter than the grounded bottles in references 2 and 4.

Vertical rhythm of the right rail is uneven: logo baseline 626 to title top 720 leaves a 94px gap, while title bottom 873 to the rule at 1008 leaves 135px of empty nacre, and nothing below the rule balances the 430px of empty column down to the canvas bottom; the column visually drifts instead of sitting as a measured tide-scale as briefed.

changes.value: Mother-of-pearl shell inlay wall in cool pale blue-grey with fine matte nacre flakes set in a slow low-contrast swirl, meeting a continuous matching nacre shell ground at a horizontal horizon six tenths down the frame, very subdued iridescent sheen, smooth even value across the right half of the frame with no bright sparkle clusters, soft high-key diffuse illumination, matte shell grain, no objects
